newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Dull Estonia share trade grinds prices down.
newsitem.headline: Dull Estonia share trade grinds prices down.

text.p: Dull trade on the Estonian bourse on Tuesday took prices down as investors waited for April's results to kick start the market, dealers said.
The Talse fell by 1.30 percent to close on 263.62 kroons with 37.9 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"It was a very slow day. Forekspank made an effort to rise higher in the morning but was pulled down," one trader said.
"Investors are hoping the market will hold until April's results come in next week with the expectation that good results will take stocks higher," he added.
Forekspank turned over 12.6 million kroons of shares to close on 188.00 kroons on a loss of 1.75 kroons.
"Forekspank made good gains this morning but the selling mood brought it back with the rest," another dealer added.
Hansapank turned over 11.9 million kroons of shares to be 2.30 kroons lower on 138.70 kroons.
The over-the-counter market trade was down to 5.8 million kroons of trade with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma closed on 76.00 kroons, down 1.30 kroons, after 3.5 million kroons of shares changed hands.
